_instructions: One entry per review item: {"points": <int>, "verdict": "<one line>", "reasoning": "<why, referencing the code>", "evidence": ["<file:line or snippet>"]}. points must be between 0 and the item maximum shown below.

record_codec_declarative.criterion: 记录格式集中在 record.py，用 struct 或等价的声明式方式表达头部布局，不是散落各处的手工字节切片；编码与解码共用同一份字段定义

truncation_vs_corruption.criterion: 截断与损坏的区分有明确且单一的判定点（IncompleteRecordError 与 CorruptRecordError 分开抛、由 scan 统一转译），不是靠散落的 try/except 兜住

atomic_compaction.criterion: 压实顺序正确：先写 tmp、再 os.replace、最后删旧段；tmp 名字不匹配段文件模式，且中途崩溃可恢复
